title: WorkflowRun
description: A running or completed workflow instance and its state-machine position. See punakawan-go-typescript-detailed-plan.md §9, §18.1.

objective.description: Human-readable goal of this run, set by the calling agent at creation or advance time. Used by the panel's session summary (punakawan-panel-implementation-plan.md §8.3); Punakawan never infers or edits this itself.

initiator.description: Who or what started this run (e.g. "user", "scheduled", an agent identifier). Set by the calling agent, not inferred.

active_role.description: The Punakawan role currently driving this run, as reported by the calling agent.

definition_ref.description: Immutable reference to the workflow definition this run was created from (agent-context plan §4.1). Absent for ad hoc runs, which record their path through capability events and the outcome instead of pretending a definition existed. Present for definition-aware runs so the run records the exact id, revision, and content hash that produced it — replacing the old convention of encoding the definition id inside `objective`.

content_hash.description: sha256:<hex> fingerprint of the definition content at invocation time.

inputs.description: Resolved workflow inputs at invocation time (agent-context plan §4.1/§4.4): declared inputs with caller-supplied values or declared defaults applied. Values are arbitrary JSON.

context_snapshot.description: Bounded, immutable snapshot of the context this run was prepared with (agent-context plan §4.1). Holds references and hashes, never a copy of the whole knowledge store. Fully populated by the context preparation service (plan §4.4); at invocation only the `missing` list and revision may be set.

digest.description: sha256:<hex> digest covering the definition reference, selected metadata, selected knowledge references and hashes, role-config revision, and inputs.

missing.description: Context the run needs but could not resolve. A non-empty list drives the run into awaiting-clarification (plan §4.1).

step_progress.description: Per-step execution state initialized from the definition's steps at invocation and advanced as steps run (agent-context plan §4.1/§5.3). Absent for ad hoc runs.

role_config_revision.description: The roles.yaml revision in effect when this run was created (plan §50, ROLE-012). Stamped once at creation so a historical run remains reproducible even after the project role configuration is later edited.

effective_role_settings.description: Snapshot of the effective role settings (enabled/style/mode/capabilities) for each of the four roles at run-creation time (plan §50, ROLE-012). A map keyed by role name; values are permissive objects so the snapshot stays forward-compatible with future role-config fields.
